name: Documentation
description: Files beside a product — a specification sheet, a manual, drawings, certificates — or links to them on the maker's site, in a section of the product page of their own. Each may be for everyone or for signed-in customers only.

settings.default: pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, odt, ods, rtf, txt, csv, zip, 7z, rar, dwg, dxf, step, stp, stl, jpg, jpeg, png, webp
settings.label: Types of files accepted
settings.help: Extensions, comma separated. The type is read from the file itself, not from its name. Programs, web pages and SVG are never accepted, whatever is listed here.

settings.label: Largest file, MB
settings.help: The server's own upload limit may be lower; then that one decides.
